name: Children Being Obedient
overview: Scripture commands children to obey and honor their parents as an expression of righteousness and submission to God's order, as seen in Ephesians 6:1 and the repeated Old Testament injunctions to honor father and mother. The serious consequences for cursing or reviling parents, including death as stated in Exodus 21:17, Deuteronomy 27:16, Matthew 15:4, and Mark 7:10, underscore the gravity of this command. Additionally, fathers are instructed not to provoke their children but to nurture them with godly discipline, reflecting a balanced approach to obedience and upbringing in the Lord (Ephesians 6:4).
